published.citation: Hord et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5082.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5670 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 53532 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
